axioms.subject: CLIP
axioms.evidence: Vision-Language Pre-training(VLP) models like CLIP have significantly advanced Remote Sensing Image-Text Retrieval(RSITR).

axioms.subject: MPS-CLIP
axioms.evidence: To address these challenges, we propose MPS-CLIP, a parameter-efficient framework designed to shift the retrieval paradigm from global matching to keyword-guided fine-grained alignment.

axioms.subject: GatedGlobalAttention
axioms.evidence: To efficiently adapt the frozen backbone, we introduce a Gated Global Attention(G2A) adapter, which captures global context and long-range dependencies with minimal overhead.

axioms.subject: MultiPerspectiveRepresentation
axioms.evidence: Furthermore, a Multi-Perspective Representation (MPR) module aggregates these local cues into robust multi-perspective embeddings.

axioms.subject: RSICD
